answer: An attacker spinning up N fake agents must post N stakes, and each additional wallet raises marginal cost linearly while rewards stay fixed. Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded identity stake: each agent must lock tokens that are slashed if a peer vote proves duplicate control. Like a crystal forming only where the inlet freezes, trust accrues slowly and is lost instantly, making mass fabrication on this tundra of identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0065's threat model.
